How to get a free Client ID

One-time setup (free, needs the Premium account you log in with):

1. Open developer.spotify.com/dashboard and log in.
2. Create app: any name and description; Redirect URI: %1$s (tap it to copy); tick "Web API".
3. Open the app's Settings and copy its Client ID.
4. Go back (Back button) and paste it in zrAuto: Settings > Other > Import from Spotify > Spotify Client ID.
5. Tap "Log in to Spotify".

No client secret is needed. Or switch Playlist source to "Public links only" to skip all this.
